remarks: In the Heart of New Canaan, enjoy the best of "in-town living" with this lovely refreshed 2-bedroom condo, ideally located directly across from Mead Park. Start your mornings with a peaceful walk in the park and take advantage of everything this vibrant neighborhood has to offer: close to New Canaan Train Station, local shops, restaurants, and grocery stores, this home offers unmatched convenience for commuters and those who love being close to everything! Freshly painted, the home feels bright, clean, and move-in ready. Enjoy the ease of first-floor living with both a front and back door, providing easy access to your parking spot. HEAT and WATER are INCLUDED in the rent, adding extra value and comfort. A rare opportunity to enjoy a prime location, modern updates and effortless living, right in the center of charming New Canaan. Photos coming soon...
